purpose: Heavy Rebuild v2 clean-master architectural and process program for the authoritative district heating station asset, preserving a legible fuel-or-primary-heat to boiler/heat-exchanger to pumped hot-water distribution workflow, operator control, maintenance access, terrain seating, and coherent damage behavior.
ground_program: controlled utility-site approach with staff entry, service-vehicle access and a road connection appropriate to a district energy plant rather than a generic paved apron
fuel receiving or primary-heat interface visibly precedes the generation stage; where combustion is used, unloading, storage and feed systems connect credibly to boiler equipment

boiler or primary heat-production hall contains supported major equipment, combustion or heat-source service clearances, feed systems and exhaust or heat-rejection routing appropriate to the selected technology
heat-exchanger and circulation-pump zones follow heat production and connect directly to paired district supply and return mains so the input-process-output sequence is inferable from layout
water treatment, makeup-water and expansion/pressure-control functions connect credibly to the closed-loop heating network instead of appearing as unrelated tanks
control room and operator workspace overlook or directly access the principal generation and distribution equipment and contain monitoring, alarm, records and operating functions
electrical switchgear, motor-control and backup-power spaces are segregated from wet process areas while retaining credible cable routes to pumps, fans and plant equipment
mechanical workshop, parts storage and maintenance staging provide believable access to boilers, exchangers, pumps, valves and heavy components
service yard supports deliveries, ash or waste handling where applicable, maintenance laydown and emergency access without crossing principal staff circulation
foundations, trenches, buried-main transitions, drainage and grade changes seat the plant into terrain without floating pipework, unsupported machinery or a monolithic artificial platform
upper_program: supported galleries and catwalks provide maintenance access to boiler tops, headers, valves, fans and elevated pipework with continuous player headroom and guarded edges
any occupied upper operator, electrical or administration spaces connect through an enclosed supported stair core with usable landings
chimneys, stacks or exhaust structures are structurally seated, connected to the relevant heat-production equipment and provided with believable maintenance access
pipe racks and utility bridges follow supported routes between generation equipment and district-main interfaces and do not terminate in open air
roof zones distinguish boiler hall, pump/exchanger volumes, control spaces and service plant while retaining drainage and maintenance access
circulation: operator circulation forms a continuous route from staff entry and control functions through heat production, heat exchange, pumping and district-main monitoring points
maintenance circulation reaches boilers, exchangers, pumps, valves, electrical rooms, water-treatment equipment and stack bases without requiring passage through controlled operator offices
fuel-delivery or primary-energy service routes remain distinct from ordinary staff movement wherever the site layout permits
service vehicles can reach delivery, maintenance and waste-handling areas through believable yard geometry and turning clearances
every occupied elevated level and service gallery retains a supported route to grade through architectural stairs, with ladders reserved for equipment-only access
damage_constraints: the damaged derivative must remain immediately recognizable as a district heating plant through surviving generation equipment, heat exchangers or pumps, paired supply-return mains, control functions and distribution relationships
favor localized boiler or pipe rupture, steam or water damage, corrosion, pump failure, roof collapse, electrical fire, stack damage and vegetation intrusion over uniform random deletion
major structural breaches must use irregular fracture geometry with gravity-consistent rubble, failed pipework or displaced equipment below and around the affected zone
damage to a wall, platform, pipe rack or opening must resolve attached glazing, doors, signs, ladders and fixtures so no floating remnants remain
preserve at least one legible exploration route spanning the heat source or receiving zone, generation equipment, exchanger/pump systems, control functions and district supply-return interface
damage may disable individual plant stages but must not erase the generation-to-distribution story or reduce the site to an arbitrary industrial shell
derive damaged, occupied or contaminated variants only from this immutable clean master

production_admission.note: Authored program is a prerequisite only. Do not add this asset to production-approvals.json until the authoritative v2 automated gate has actually been run and its passing evidence retained.
